entities.summary: Maria Vittoria of Savoy was a legitimated daughter of Victor Amadeus II of Sardinia, first king of the House of Savoy. Married to the head of a cadet branch of the House of Savoy, she is an ancestress of the kings of Sardinia and of the Savoy kings of Italy.
